title: Ottawa Daytime Chocolate Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A decadent walking tour for the True Chocolate lovers! Indulge your sweet tooth as you explore the ByWard Market with a local guide, discovering rich, surprising chocolate creations along the way.

Indulge in all things CHOCOLATE!
Let us take you in a guide walk you through the ByWard Market and help you discover the many forms and tastes of chocolate.

This tour highlights some of the best chocolate creations the ByWard Market neighbourhood has to offer!
